text: せかいで　いちばん　よわくて　なさけない　ポケモンだ。

structure.jp: せかいで　いちばん
よわくて　なさけない

patterns.name: 〜でいちばん
patterns.span: せかいで　いちばん
patterns.explanation: で gives the group you are comparing within, and いちばん says 'the most'. せかいで　いちばん　よわくて = 'the weakest in the world'.

patterns.name: 〜くて
patterns.span: よわくて　なさけない
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to くて joins it to the next describing word with 'and'. よわくて　なさけない = 'weak and pathetic'.
